text: Code reviews are an important part of software development. When developers review each other's code before it is merged, they can catch bugs early, when problems are still easy and cheap to fix. Code reviews also support knowledge sharing, because team members learn how different parts of the system work and discover new techniques from one another. In addition, regular reviews help maintain team quality by keeping the code clean, consistent, and easy to understand. Although code reviews take time, they save much more time later and help build a stronger, more confident team.
